titre: Centres de données en chantier dans les Amériques
sous_titre: Gigawatts de capacité en construction, de la mi 2025 à la mi 2026

Mi 2025.texte: Construction activity stands at a record 12.1 GW underway, with nearly 89% of that space pre-leased before delivery.

Fin 2025.texte: 25.3 GW of data center capacity is currently under construction across the region

Mi 2026.texte: Development activity reached a record 37.7GW under construction with a 91.7% precommitment rate.
